full_details: At nine Garnish showed the K and would not put a number under it. Kemp was edged and still said you. The two stops stayed. The songs stayed. Nick was not fetched. Nothing was bought. The Rose had a Siege of London. You did not go. At two you played Egeon in the Errors. After supper you wrote the Rose into the almanac: Long Meg, to the yard. The moon-line was already printed. You did not send Sunday's letter.
one_sentence: You rehearsed, played Egeon again, and set the Rose down for tomorrow.
title: Played Egeon again and set Friday for the Rose
